comment.narrative: On 23 September 2021 amendments to the Constitution were passed to expressly provide that the SCM is the guarantor of the independence of the judicial authority. The Prosecutor General and the Minister of Justice will not be members of the SCM. The Council will consist of 12 members 6 judge members elected by the General Assembly of Judges and 6 lay members elected by the Parliament. The tenure of SCM members will be 6 years. The SCM will be consulted in the process of elaboration examination approval and modification of the state budget in relation to the allocation of funds to the courts. The SCM will be entitled to propose amendments to the documents submitted for consultation. The prevetting process of the candidates to the membership in the SCM commenced in April 2022.
The national legislation is to a large extent in compliance with Council of Europe standards.
